title: Multitarget synthetic piperates against key drug targets of Alzheimer's and diabetes mellitus
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17085-17113
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00843G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Asif Ahmad, Uzma Salar, Musa Özil, Nimet Baltaş, Maria Nasim, Aaqib Ullah, Zaheer Ul-Haq, Khalid Mohammed Khan, Farzana Shaheen
A library of piperate derivatives 3–25 was synthesized in a two-step reaction scheme starting from piperine 1, which was converted to piperic acid 2 first, and then reacted with various alkyl and aryl halides to afford the final products.
